page: Amazon Web Services m8id.12xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs (24 physical cores with 2 threads per core) utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processor is an Intel Xeon 6975P-C running at 3.9 GHz, equipped with a 480 MB L3 cache and advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions). The system is configured with 192.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is provided via a 2850 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and baseline network bandwidth is rated at 22 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong memory subsystem performance, with read-only memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks placing in the top 25% of tested systems, though large block write bandwidth remains in the middle 50%. Computational benchmarks show strong performance in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, as well as Passmark CPU and memory evaluations. The instance demonstrates top-tier performance (top 10%) in image and text processing. For database operations, the server achieves strong results in Passmark database tests and Redis SET operations, alongside strong static web serving throughput.

The inclusion of local NVMe SSD storage and high-speed DDR5 memory provides high resource density, making this instance class qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring fast local scratch space without the overhead of network-attached storage. However, a tradeoff exists between its strong read-only memory bandwidth and its average multi-core CPU stress-ng performance. The hardware configuration and benchmark profile make this instance suitable for database hosting, text and image processing pipelines, software compilation, and medium-scale language model inference.
